title: PushRegistration
description: Sent by the mobile app on every start (REQ-REL-035) so the backend can push alerts through FCM HTTP v1. One registration per app install: a new token for the same app_instance_id replaces the old one. Carries no personal or health data; the user is taken from the JWT, not from this body.

app_instance_id.description: Random UUID generated once per app install and kept in app storage; makes the registration an upsert, so a reinstall or token refresh never leaves a duplicate subscription.

fcm_token.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging registration token. Revoked by the backend as soon as FCM answers Unregistered.

app_version.description: Semantic version of the app, e.g. 0.3.1.

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag used to word the notification, e.g. vi-VN. Defaults to vi-VN.
